text: 你叫醒查理、诺曼和西尔维娅，告诉他们刚才发生的事，并要求他们帮忙。三人一边打哈欠一边揉着眼睛。
“不！”查理抓住你，“我们不能去找那个男孩！他听见了伟大的风行者的召唤，已经不属于你了。我们必须逃走！”

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 71
text: You rouse Charlie, Norman, and Sylvia. As they yawn and blink, you tell them what happened and demand their help.
“No!” Charlie grabs you. “We must not seek the boy! He has heard the call of the Great Wind-Walker. He is lost to you. We must flee!”
